partners.title: Partner connections
partners.hint: One Nexora partner list: configure links and monitor notices. When you ship you are the supplier for that direction; when you receive you are the receiving party — no separate supplier/customer masters.
partners.editHint: Update trading name, contact email, or status. Internal code and system ID stay fixed.
partners.empty: No partners yet. Add a partner to start linking.
partners.createHint: Enter the partner enterprise details. The system ID is provided by the partner.
partners.systemIdHint: Fixed ID of the partner’s system — do not invent a short nickname.
partners.guideIntro: Two Nexora enterprises link once. On each ship–receive document, the shipper is the supplier and the receiver is the receiving party for that direction.
partners.guideStep1: Both sides use Nexora; each runs on its own domain or server.
partners.guideStep2: Exchange system IDs and authorization details over a secure internal channel (not public chat).
partners.guideStep3: You add the partner, enter their system address, and save the link.
partners.guideStep4: The partner does the same for you — both directions are required for full send/receive.
partners.guideStep5: Click Check link. Only then ship/receive between enterprises (ship = supplier; receive = receiving party for that direction).
partners.guideStep6: If delivery fails: use the link monitoring section on this page to resend or reprocess notices.
partners.notifyUrlHint: Usually filled from the system address. Change only if the partner provides another URL.
partners.authUrlHint: Address the partner uses to grant send permission (provided by the partner).
partners.outboundSecretHint: Enter a safe reference only (e.g. env:PARTNER_B_SECRET). Do not paste raw secrets on screen.
partners.inboundClientId: Partner code allowed to send to us
partners.testOk: Setup is saved and active. Two-way linking only works after the partner configures their side too.
partners.testMissing: Link is not configured yet. Finish the steps and click Save link.
partners.testDisabled: Link is paused. Turn it back on before sending or receiving notices.
partners.testError: Could not check the link. Try again or contact an administrator.
partners.forbidden: You do not have permission to manage partners.
partners.fillRequired: Please fill in all required fields.

linkOps.subtitle: Watch outbound and inbound notice queues with partners. Sensitive content is hidden.

catalog.productsIndexHint: Browse products in a table. Open a row to edit profile, variants, and prices.
catalog.emptyVariants: No variants yet. Add SKU or barcode on the General tab, then save.
catalog.emptyPriceItems: No price lines on this list yet.
catalog.createHint: Name and category are required. Optional SKU/barcode creates the primary selling variant.
catalog.editorCreateHint: Fill general info, units, and list prices. After creating the product you can upload images (PNG/JPEG).
catalog.editorEditHint: Edit product profile, selling codes, and commercial prices.
catalog.imagesSaveFirst: Save the product before uploading images.
catalog.imagesScanTimeout: Image scan timed out — try again later.
catalog.activateHint: Inactive products stay hidden from sales and stock slips.
catalog.genNameRequired: Enter a product name before generating codes.
catalog.genCodeFailed: Could not generate a suggested code.
catalog.priceListHint: Saved to the default price list when a selling variant exists. Existing lines are not overwritten yet.
catalog.stockCostHint: Catalog cost is a reference; outbound stock follows inbound lots first.
catalog.extraUomsHint: Example: 1 box = 24 pieces. Stored on the product until variant-UOM APIs are wired.
catalog.inventoryTabHint: Selling variants and shortcuts to lots / balances.
catalog.salesTabHint: Commercial prices for the primary unit. Full price-list tools live under Pricing.
catalog.detailHint: Update product profile and manage selling variants (SKU / barcode).
catalog.categoriesHint: Category tree for classifying products. Nested rows show depth under the parent.
catalog.uomHint: Unit of measure master. System default is CÁI and cannot be removed.
catalog.uomNormalizeHint: Names are normalized on save (for example cái → CÁI). Duplicates return a conflict.
catalog.pricingHint: Commercial price lists. List prices are not inventory cost (COGS).
catalog.batchesHint: Lots attach to a product variant. New lots start in inspect until quality is confirmed.

orders.title: Orders
orders.indexHint: Commercial sales orders with stock checkout and invoice QR for trace.
orders.createHint: Use the POS screen to sell with FEFO stock and invoice QR.

orders.soldAtHint: Leave blank to use server create time.
orders.qrHint: Scan to open the public invoice trace URL.

pos.hint: Type to search products; Enter adds the top suggestion. Pay on the right.

pos.checkoutPending: POS payment is not wired yet — cart kept for further edits.
pos.confirmFailed: Draft created but confirm failed — open the order to finish.
pos.paidInsufficient: Amount tendered is less than amount due.
pos.variantRequired: Product is missing a sellable variant or UOM.
pos.warehouseHint: Stock is allocated FEFO from this warehouse on pay.
pos.issueRequired: Select a confirmed sale-purpose issue to link the order.

admin.hubBody: Manage organization and members. Catalog, inventory, and partners are separate workspaces. Secrets are never shown after save.

admin.membersBody: Staff with system access. Invite, edit profiles, and assign roles in separate dialogs.
admin.inviteHint: Enter username, display name, and one or more job roles to grant access. The system creates the sign-in account; a temporary password is shown once after a successful invite.
admin.assignRolesHint: Select one or more job roles. Changes apply after you save.
admin.emptyMembers: No members yet. Invite the first person to grant access.
admin.provisionalPasswordBody: Share this password with the member through a secure internal channel. They must change it on first sign-in.
admin.forbidden: You do not have permission for this resource.
